memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "They were going to name him after his father Zechariah, but his mother spoke up and said, 'No! He is to be called John.' —Luke 1:59–60"

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text: Your first name is personal and individual, representing the core of who you are. Unlike nicknames or last names that often limit our identity or only reflect our parents, how you truly identify yourself shapes your thoughts, actions, worldview, life path, and future. When we strip away the temporary labels assigned by the world around us, we discover that our true essence is found in the Creator. He calls each of us by name, knowing our deepest potential and walking with us through every season of transformation. This sacred identity frees us from the need to perform for acceptance or hide behind superficial titles. Instead, it invites us to step boldly into the authentic purpose we were created to fulfill. Embracing who you are allows you to align your daily choices with divine grace and eternal truth. Ultimately, your unique name is a testament to the intentional design and unconditional love God has poured into your life. ( insight from - 365 devotions to exbrace what matter most by John Michalak ).

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Who you are matters, because how you identify yourself essentially determines the life you will live."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, help us to understand our true identity in You. Guide us to look beyond labels, nicknames, or ancestral definitions, and embrace the unique individual purpose You have called us to live out each day. In Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Take a moment today to remember that your identity is uniquely designed by God, forming the solid foundation for every choice and dream ahead.
